title: A refused save: how a rule protects data
goal: Exercise the existing ПередЗаписью through real object writes, correct two defects and reread the accepted request.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P4. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A form field looks mandatory, but code can save without opening the form. Where should the rule live so a programmatic save also checks it? Observe refusal, correction, and preservation of the last valid value.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Defaults are not validation
paragraphs: Defaults help create an object but do not validate later writing. Another form, exchange or programmatic call can change values. Separate convenient filling from mandatory validation. Customer, service and duration rules belong at a reliable write boundary; UI explains them to people.

ПередЗаписью belongs to the ЗаявкаУслуги object module. It checks customer, service, status and the 0..1440 range, setting Отказ. The function exercises this rule with actual object writes. This alone does not establish a universal access policy: permissions, external sources and alternate mutation paths require separate analysis.

sections.title: Prepare the experiment while retaining P4
paragraphs: Continue your own P4 copy after preserving its DT and sources. Do not load a full configuration over prior work. If using the supplied training template, load service-desk-documents-v2 into a new separate infobase and distinguish it from your continuing work.

ЗаявкаУслуги needs Клиент, Услуга, Статус, ДлительностьМинут and Комментарий. ПередЗаписью must refuse missing customer/service/status and minutes outside 0…1440. Review the existing handler first; do not create another procedure of the same name.
Keep the existing УчебныеДанные common module. Append the new function outside existing definitions; the application calls it once. Posting is not required for these observations.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The main function attempts three saves: with no customer, with 1441 minutes, then with corrected 30. The first two must refuse without creating a request. The last saves customer, service and 30 minutes; a fresh read checks those exact fields.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.
The first two messages are expected refusal reasons emitted by ПередЗаписью. They do not indicate failure of the entire experiment. Three labelled assertions follow.

sections.title: BeforeWrite sees the object
paragraphs: BeforeWrite receivesCancel and document-writing parameters. It can enforce invariants and reject the operation. Do not reference a particular form’s controls: objects can be written without that form. Messages should identify invalid fields, but a missing message does not make a canceled write successful.

First attempt a write with no customer; next supply the customer but use 1441 minutes. Both refusals should leave the new document reference empty. Correct to 30, write the same object and reread customer/service/duration. Preserving input lets the learner fix one field instead of rebuilding the entire form.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: Memory now holds 1441, but ПередЗаписью refused the save. What will a fresh read of the earlier saved 1440 show?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: 1440. The editable object can still contain the refused 1441 while the database retains the last successfully saved 1440. Freshly read the database instead of displaying the same object field.

sections.title: Handler repeatability
paragraphs: Repeated writing must not add another bonus document or accumulate customer minutes without an accounting rule. Side effects need idempotency and transactional linkage. Begin with input validation and add effects only under explicit requirements. Write identical data twice and compare every affected dataset.

Do not define a second ПередЗаписью or nest it inside application startup. Inspect and preserve the existing handler, combining changes only in a copy. Place the exported experiment function in a server common module; startup contains only the call. Do not disable validation to obtain a passing message.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The diagram follows the worked example’s three attempts. Refusal ends an attempt, not the entire exercise. Correcting the fields allows the next save to succeed.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Displaying a warning in ПередЗаписью without setting Отказ=Истина can still allow invalid data to save. A warning message alone does not refuse the operation.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Bypassing UI is a required control
paragraphs: Attempt invalid programmatic writing in a copy. If the form rejects−1 but the object accepts it, the rule protects one route only. Compare document count and prior values. Follow with a valid write. Exchange-loading behavior needs an explicit policy rather than universally disabling invariants.

The negative control substitutes valid 1440 for invalid 1441. It compiles, but the expected-refusal assertion no longer passes. This demonstrates discrimination across the boundary, not exhaustive coverage of all values or UI messages. Add 0, 1440, a negative value and empty references to your own scenario table.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: With customer, service and status filled, test minute boundaries:-1 is refused on a new object, 0 saves, and 1440 then saves to that same request. Attempting 1441 must refuse; a fresh read retains 1440 and the same reference.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.
